display.purpose: Home hero and major entry statements only.

headline.purpose: Page titles and primary product headings.

title.purpose: Panel headers, item names, and compact section labels.

body.purpose: Readable interface copy and helper text.

label.purpose: Forms, badges, compact metadata, and controls.

shadows.name: none-at-rest
shadows.purpose: Default depth model for panels, cards, item rows, buttons, and fields.

shadows.name: interactive-lift
shadows.purpose: Optional focus or temporary overlay lift only.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, copied, and selected state transitions.

motion.name: showcase-scroll
motion.purpose: Product showcase preview only; replaced by manual scrolling with reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action in a local area: create, save, reserve, or open an important flow.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid #0F61C7; border-radius: 8px; background: #0F61C7; color: #FFFFFF; font: 650 16px/1.2 Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #0C4FA3; border-color: #0C4FA3; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(15, 97, 199, 0.28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action that stays familiar and low-noise.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid #8BBCC8; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #102033; font: 650 16px/1.2 Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #AED9E0; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(15, 97, 199, 0.22); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard product field for URLs, names, settings, and auth forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #102033; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 700; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #8BBCC8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 11px 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #102033; font: 400 16px/1.2 Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #46606A; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(15, 97, 199, 0.22); border-color: #0F61C7; }

components.name: Status Badges
components.description: Reservation and visibility state labels that pair text with color.
components.css: .ds-badges { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 9px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 750; } .ds-badge-available { background: #BCF8EC; color: #102033; } .ds-badge-reserved { background: #0F61C7; color: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Wishlist Item Row
components.description: Dense, scannable item row for public and owner wishlist views.
components.css: .ds-item-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #8BBCC8; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px; color: #102033; font-family: Poppins, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-thumb { width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 8px; background: #AED9E0; } .ds-item-copy { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 5px; } .ds-item-copy strong { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-item-copy span { color: #46606A; font-size: 13px; } .ds-badge { border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 9px; background: #BCF8EC; color: #102033; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 750; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-button-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 11px; border: 1px solid #0F61C7; border-radius: 8px; background: #0F61C7; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview: Wantlist should feel like a bright, organized table where people can place gift ideas, see what is available, and act without social friction. The system is a product UI first: familiar controls, readable forms, predictable lists, and restrained motion. The color palette brings a vibrant social pulse, but the interface stays light and simple so casual users can use it without visual fatigue.
keyCharacteristics: Familiar product controls with an approachable social tone.
Bright palette used as state and hierarchy, not decoration.
Rounded but not over-soft geometry, centered on 8px and 12px radii.
Clear ownership, privacy, and reservation states.
Light surfaces that do not tire the eye.

rules.name: The Social Blue Rule
rules.body: Primary action, selected state, and reserved state share Social Blue so users learn one confident action color.

rules.name: The Yellow Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Signal Yellow is an accent, not a background theme. If more than 10% of a screen is yellow, the screen is shouting.

rules.name: The No Purple SaaS Rule
rules.body: Purple gradients, blue-purple glow, glassmorphism, and low-contrast pastel text are prohibited.

rules.name: The Product Sans Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce display fonts for labels, buttons, data, or navigation. Familiarity is the point.

rules.name: The No Whisper Text Rule
rules.body: Muted copy must stay readable. Never use pale gray or low-contrast pastel text on mint or sky surfaces.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Use white, mint, soft sky, and 1px lines to create depth before reaching for shadow.

dos: Do use Social Blue for primary actions, reserved states, and selected controls.
Do keep most surfaces white, Mint Paper, or Soft Sky so the product remains light and easy on the eyes.
Do pair every state color with text labels like "Disponivel", "Reservado", "Seu", or "Privada".
Do keep component geometry consistent: 8px radius for controls, 12px only for softer media containers.
Do respect reduced motion; the showcase scroll may pause or become manually scrollable.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS purple, purple-blue gradients, decorative glow, or glassmorphism.
Don't use low-contrast pastel text on mint, sky, yellow, or white backgrounds.
Don't make yellow a large page background or default button color.
Don't add thick side-stripe borders to cards, rows, alerts, or empty states.
Don't invent unusual form controls, modals, or navigation patterns when standard product controls work.
